description: Turn one bot flow (auto-reply conversation of any type: simple, buttons, template or list) ON or OFF by ID. An OFF flow stays saved but the bot stops answering its keywords. Asking for the state it is already in changes nothing. A buttons/template flow with no buttons, or a list flow with no sections, cannot be turned ON until it is completed in the panel. This does NOT switch the whole bot (use toggle_bot) and does not edit the reply (use update_bot_conversation). Run get_bot_conversations with enabled_only=false to find IDs.

active.description: true to turn the flow ON, false to turn it OFF

id.description: ID of the bot flow (from get_bot_conversations)

name: set_bot_conversation_active
